City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  October 19, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the 1st Floor, Finance Conference Room at
11:32 a.m.:

  Members Present:  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman, City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office (Call-In)

  Staff Present:  Sabrina Barnes, Parks and Recreation Community Services
  Derald Brenneman, City Attorney’s Office
  Robert Chavez, Housing
  Serena Martinez, Human Resources

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Peggy Velasquez reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of October 12, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Express Medical Clinic, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for health
  services provided in the amount of $3,958.00. Motion carried unanimously.

3. CAHA paid for Nan McKay & Associates, Inc.– Executive session to discuss recommend payment
  for Project-Based voucher training for the Housing Authority in the amount of $765.00. Motion
  carried unanimously.

4. A-Throne – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for the portable restrooms and
  sinks during restroom construction in the amount of $1,028.56. Motion carried unanimously.

Closed Session - Confidential

5. Closed session-Confidential-Attorney/Client Privileged; Executive closed session Claims Review
  Committee with Legal Counsel regarding pending litigation pursuant to California Government
  Code §54956.9(d)(2)); Willa Bryant Claim for Damages. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Peggy Velasquez reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting
adjourned at 11:45 a.m. Adjournment
